name: Abbadomon Core
look: a tall cloaked knight of tattered navy eye-ribbons with red eyes staring from the folds, crimson armour beneath and a long crimson blade for an arm
entry: The core of Abbadomon, unwound: a cloaked knight of tattered eye-ribbons with a crimson blade for an arm. Whatever it cuts is not destroyed but erased, as if it had never been.
